verdict.rationale: Paddle publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec (developer.paddle.com/sdks/specs/openapi.md, maintained at github.com/PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi) explicitly for generating client libraries and editor tooling, plus an importable Postman collection, giving AI-native users machine-readable API access. missing for 10: the exact download URL (e.g. openapi.json) 404'd in a live probe, meaning discovery requires going through the docs page/GitHub repo rather than a single canonical endpoint.
